settings.text: We value our global community of fashion lovers visiting our online store and we understand your concerns about purchasing genuine products. All of our luxury pieces are 100% authentic. The majority of our luxury pieces are sourced from a close and trusted network. When we receive a luxury item from a seller we evaluate the physical item and compare the product to the original item description, check the quality (seams, buttons, zippers, linings etc) and we research any signs that the product may not be authentic. We do not sell fakes or replicas. If you have any questions regarding your order, please do not hesitate to contact us at info@mycircularwardrobe.com.
